Abstract excerpt: LLM-based agents are rapidly moving from research prototypes into the core business processes of organizations, but these agents pose deployment risks to security, compliance, and functionality. In this article, we argue that risk-free deployment must be grounded in the agent's trajectory: the recorded sequence of reasoning steps, tool invocations, and environmental observations. Trajectories are available for any agent, and many failures are visible only in the trajectory.
